articles.title: Fifa criticises campaign to oust president Infantino
articles.summary: Fifa strongly criticises what it calls a "concerted and ongoing effort" to "undermine" the organisation and its president Gianni Infantino.

articles.title: FIFA hits out at critics trying to 'undermine' Infantino
articles.summary: FIFA has hit out at "a concerted and ongoing effort by some to undermine" the governing body and president Gianni Infantino over claims surrounding his conduct at UEFA.
